_comment: Format example only; the values are placeholders and must be supplied by the football analyst. Copy to config/open_truncation_quantiles.json to enable the Asian handicap truncation check. late_p95_lead_minutes: in the group, 95 percent of normal matches have their first 5DollarFootballAPI history record at least this many minutes before kickoff; a first record later than that is marked open.status = suspect_truncated and backtest_eligible = false. league = null is the book-only fallback group, used when the book plus league group has fewer samples than min_samples. When the file does not exist, no truncation check is made. See api/app/open_status.py.
